svg.title: Dynamic-sampling GRPO training dynamics
svg.desc: Four panels show 25-update moving averages of policy loss, rollout reward, and final correctness before and after the weights-only resume point.
svg.text: MATH L3/4 · gated PRM reward (λ = 0.2) · 25-update moving average
The run resumed from step 500 with weights only; phases are shown separately because the learning-rate schedule restarted.
Blue: reward; coral: final correctness. Source: exp4_dynamic_sampling_1000_results.tar.gz · 998 logged updates · not a held-out evaluation curve.
